tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The RG-EW6000GX 6000M Wi-Fi 6 Mesh Router is a powerful next-generation wireless solution designed for ultra-fast internet, seamless coverage, and high-density device connectivity. Powered by Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology and equipped with a 2.5G Ethernet port, this router is ideal for smart homes, gaming setups, and small to medium offices in Bangladesh.


With Reyee Mesh Technology, the RG-EW6000GX ensures stable, high-speed Wi-Fi coverage across large areas while supporting multiple users and bandwidth-hungry applications such as 4K streaming, online gaming, and video conferencing.


Key Features


  • Ultra-Fast Wi-Fi 6 Speed up to 6000Mbps
  • Dual-Band 2.4GHz & 5GHz with 160MHz Channel
  • 2.5Gbps WAN/LAN Port for High-Speed Internet
  • Reyee Mesh Technology for Whole-Home Coverage
  • Supports Up to 300+ Connected Devices
  • Gaming & QoS Optimization for Low Latency
  • Advanced Security with WPA3 Encryption
  • Easy Setup & Cloud Management via Reyee App
